implementation.normal_poem: Source-first Original choice uses the source-language symbol with a small uppercase ORIGINAL badge; the two translation symbols keep their usual size and alignment. Full Original/language names and translation availability stay in accessible labels/tooltips.
implementation.quiet_reader: Original moved from settings to the visible top controls. Exactly three choices for the current poem; source-named shortcut is hidden. Each opening identifies Original or translation and source language.
implementation.preference: Original follows each poem; named target-language preferences survive a source change. Disabled translations use existing original fallback, visibly identified.
implementation.mixed_page: Controls follow the visible opening or continuing poem. Reading position/bookmark anchors match that context, preserving position during repagination.
implementation.compatibility: Source-language URLs and saved page bookmarks map to Original; native language storage keys and passage offsets unchanged.
implementation.responsive: All three language buttons are 44px wide/high. The ORIGINAL badge uses the interface font at 8.5px, with the source glyph at 20px aligned with the other two glyphs. One-row regular and quiet controls verified at 320px; English-source quiet reading also checked at 390px.
implementation.unchanged: Poetry, authored translations/credits, data catalogue, edition/catalogue controls, homepage language selection, compact masthead/menu, comments/likes services, consent and release gates.
